data.name: Sudeb
data.gender_notes: Sudeb is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is good, virtuous and prosperous. The name Sudeb carries the meaning “Good, Prosperous” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Sudeb usually hope their child will grow to embody good, prosperous and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Sudeb belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good, Prosperous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sudeb total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
